mostWorthwhile.text: Making the hydrothermal vent was most worthwhile: it linked volcanic heat and seawater to chemistry that can support life without sunlight.

leastWorthwhile.text: The continent sequence felt fairly predictable once rainfall produced weathered rock; rivers were the obvious next choice.

surprise.text: Combining moving plates with water produced a subduction trench rather than the hot spring I expected.

arbitrary.text: Moving plates plus water producing a trench felt somewhat indirect, although the result explained subduction; the menu supplied compatibility rather than letting me discover it.

continue.text: Yes. The concise geological explanations and connections to life made me curious about how the world develops next, even if some choices were predictable.
